pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Bubba G's sittin' on top like he stole the crown jewels, while Mustard Boy's slide down the mountain faster than gravy on Thanksgiving dinner.** Gunner's got France and their baguette-loving skills racking up points like he paid 'em in croissants, sittin' pretty with 47. Meanwhile, Devin's Ghost Pepper is hot on his heels, five points back, tryin' to make a run with Spain's finesse — though Zach's Brazil ain't helpin' him one bit 'cause Austria got cooked 3-0, leaving him with a goose egg in his basket yesterday. Gayden, aka The Backpass Assassin, is stuck in neutral with England, more worried 'bout not losin' than winnin'. And let's not get started on The Noisemaker, Rafe — the kid's fantasy roster looks more like a geography lesson gone wrong. Uzbekistan, really? You'd think he was draftin' countries based on their food. If Zach and Rafe wanna avoid bottom dwellerville, they better start throwin' hail marys, 'cause right now it's lookin' like Bubba G's world and they just livin' in it.
